subject: reasoning
question: Point A is 30 m to the east of Point B. Point C is 43 m to the south of Point A. Point C is 45 m to the east of Point D. Point E is 14 m to the south of Point D. Point F is 35 m to the east of Point E. In which direction is Point B with respect to Point F?
solution:
Given:

Point A is 30 m to the east of Point B.

Point C is 43 m to the south of Point A.

Point C is 45 m to the east of Point D.

Point E is 14 m to the south of Point D.

Point F is 35 m to the east of Point E.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5f54a7c1717160e72bf6cdef863284b94afdba888afdaf2a861bae3509bb1ca.png] 

So, Point B is North-west of Point F.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
